slides.title: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini: which one for which task?
slides.sub: A quick task-by-task pick, plus one prompt to try for each.
slides.voiceover: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini each have one thing they do best. Here's how to pick.

slides.label: Quick pick
slides.title: Three tools, three strengths

cols.name: ChatGPT
points: Data analysis: upload a file, it writes and runs the Python

cols.name: Claude
points: Claude Code: an agentic coding tool for real codebases
Runs in your terminal, IDE, desktop or browser

cols.name: Gemini
points: Deep Research: 1M-token context window plus web search
Can also search your Gmail, Drive and Chat

slides.voiceover: ChatGPT crunches your data, Claude ships code, Gemini digs through research and your files.

slides.label: ChatGPT · Data analysis
slides.name: The Analyst
slides.prompt: Analyze this dataset: clean and merge the columns, summarize the key trends, and build a chart of [METRIC] over [TIME PERIOD].
slides.note: Upload a file first — ChatGPT writes and runs the Python for you.
slides.voiceover: Upload a file and ChatGPT writes the Python to analyze it for you.

slides.label: Claude · Claude Code
slides.name: The Coding Agent
slides.prompt: Find the bug causing [ISSUE] in this codebase, write a test that reproduces it, then fix it and open a pull request.
slides.note: Works from your terminal, IDE, desktop app or claude.ai/code on your real repo.
slides.voiceover: Claude Code works right in your terminal to find bugs and open pull requests.

slides.label: Gemini · Deep Research
slides.name: The Researcher
slides.prompt: Research [TOPIC]: compare the leading approaches, cite your sources, and cross-check against the files in my Drive.
slides.note: Runs a multi-step research pass with a 1M-token context window.
slides.voiceover: Gemini's Deep Research runs a million-token pass across the web and your Drive.

slides.label: Rule of thumb
slides.title: When in doubt, default to this
items: ChatGPT's data analysis writes the Python for you
Claude Code works directly in your terminal or repo
Gemini Deep Research can search Gmail, Drive and Chat
slides.voiceover: Pick ChatGPT for spreadsheets, Claude Code for real repos, Gemini for deep research.

slides.label: Keep in mind
slides.title: None of this is fixed
items: All three ship new features constantly — check what your plan includes
Deep research tools run multi-step passes, not instant answers
Claude Code needs your own dev setup to actually ship the code
slides.cta: Follow for daily AI tool comparisons
slides.voiceover: All three change fast, so check your plan — and follow for more comparisons.
